step1_analysis.description: A basic NMOS differential pair, likely used as a building block in the high-speed Current Mode Logic (CML) buffers, ring oscillator delay cells, or phase detector of the 10-Gb/s CDR circuit.

paper_reference.title: A 10-Gb/s CMOS Clock and Data Recovery Circuit With a Half-Rate Binary Phase/Frequency Detector

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen tail current and load resistor in the testbench. Set to 1mA and 1kOhm for typical CML operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * R_load * C_load). With R_load=1k and parasitic C_load~10fF, f_3dB ~ 15 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High bandwidth is required for 10Gb/s operation. In this isolated testbench, it is limited only by intrinsic parasitic capacitances.

Power Consumption.description: DC power dissipation of the differential pair.

sky130_expected.reasoning: A single CML buffer stage typically consumes 1-5 mW. The 91 mW reported in the paper is for the entire CDR system.

Output Swing.description: Peak-to-peak differential voltage swing during transient operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_swing = I_tail * R_load = 1mA * 1k = 1V (single-ended peak-to-peak), so differential swing is ~2V ideally, but limited by input swing and gain.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the input amplitude. With a 200mVpp differential input and ~4.3dB gain, output swing will be around 320mVpp.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the NMOS differential pair measuring DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient output swing. A tail current source and load resistors are added to complete the CML structure.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential Pair Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N2 LABEL_NET_0 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 LABEL_NET_1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Testbench components (Tail current and Load resistors)
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
I_tail N0 0 1m
R1 VDD N2 1k
R2 VDD N3 1k

* Inputs
VCM VCM 0 0.9
VINP LABEL_NET_0 VCM dc 0 ac 0.5 sin(0 0.1 1G)
VINN LABEL_NET_1 VCM dc 0 ac -0.5 sin(0 -0.1 1G)

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis (Gain and Bandwidth)
ac dec 100 1M 100G
let out_diff = v(N2) - v(N3)
let gain_db = 20 * log10(mag(out_diff))
meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db
meas ac f3db WHEN gain_db='max_gain - 3' FALL=1
print max_gain f3db

* 3. Transient Analysis (Output Swing)
tran 1p 5n
let out_diff_tran = v(N2) - v(N3)
meas tran v_max MAX out_diff_tran
meas tran v_min MIN out_diff_tran
let v_swing = v_max - v_min
print v_swing

quit
.endc
.end
